title: Membership
summary: Membership records that an object is one of the elements of a set.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

content.plain: Membership records that an object is one of the elements of a set.
content.exact: x∈A is a primitive binary relation in common axiomatic set theories; its behavior is constrained by axioms rather than defined circularly as ‘is inside’.
content.caveat: Membership is not the same as subset inclusion.
